title: Social Media and Depression Symptoms: A Network Perspective
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network
limitations: - Student sample (non-clinical); - Potential recall bias; - Data may not meet all assumptions of multivariate normality; - Limited to linear relationships; - No formal test for centrality differences between groups.
